tenderSchedule.description: Appointment of Project Management Consultants (PMCs) for Construction of Annex Building at Haj Bhavan, Thiruminahalli Village, Hegdenagara Main Road, Bengaluru

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

Consultancy firms who have executed at least one similar nature of works for the buildings of amount as mentioned in column no.5 in a single entrustment for the last five years shall apply. The application without prerequisite eligibility (copy of notarized work done certificate shall be enclosed) will be liable for rejection.
Consultancy firms who have rendered services for similar nature of works are only eligible to apply.
Consultancy firms who are already having five works on hand in KHB are not eligible.
Firms, companies & individual persons are eligible for participation in the tender.
All the necessary documents shall be scanned and uploaded in the kppp portal. Non-submission of required documents shall be liable for rejection.
Interested applicants may access bidding documents through the Karnataka Public Procurement Portal https://kppp.karnataka.gov.in
FINANCIAL CAPACITY: Should have in the last five years period achieved during any two consecutive financial years an average annual financial turnover not less than the tender requirements.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Specific experience of the consultancy related Assignment (At-least one similar nature of completed works in a single entrustment bid anywhere in India. The completion certificate should be issued by not below the rank of Executive Engineer or Competent Authority)

Approach paper on methodology and work plan for performing the assignment. To demonstrate the approach paper on methodology consultant shall present presentation on previous executed project of similar nature of work from your firm it includes all salient features of the project. Also should have the knowledge about the recent technical codes (Presentation date will be Intimated)

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Own NABL / NAAC accredited laboratory, MOU with NABL / NAAC accredited laboratory within Karnataka State only, Own laboratory carries higher weightage.

Qualifications and competence of the key professional staff a) Qualification b) Firm having Structural Engineer c) Firm having PHE & Electrical Engineer d) Experience in handling similar nature of Projects
